vigil delta re-critique round 2 (F1-F6 CLOSED by re-measurement; refine cycle-2 bar failed, 3.8, testability 3): G-1 adds AC-140, the change's thesis test — with FETCH_WIDTH_FLOOR=1 the target holds rank 0 at k in {1,3,5} — plus AC-141, its falsifiability precondition (reverted build, floor=1, k=1, target NOT rank 0, reproducing #36 F-V1). Reproduced the floor table: fetch_width=max(k,FLOOR) makes floor LOWERING live only at k<10 and inert at k>=10, and the host gate runs k=10, so AC-138/139 probed the dead direction; both now carry scope notes. DEVIATION FROM PRESCRIPTION, deliberate: vigil proposed AC-140 as a parameterisation of AC-102, which is Layer 2, where the seed-independent mock the Terminology block mandates makes floor changes a no-op by construction — landing it there would repeat the F2 tautology in the opposite direction, so AC-140/141 are pinned to Layer 3 / the AC-125 real-GraphStore gate. G-2 adds AC-142, a population-agreement oracle for the selectivity denominator's STATUS axis: bm25_search applies no status predicate (relational.py:493-541) over an FTS index whose triggers carry deprecated rows (:75-88), while the natural denominator is active-only (count_active_by_scope_key :1019) and _is_active runs only at :482, after fusion at :424 — so w_sparse decays monotonically to 1.0 as deprecated rows accumulate, which under P0-5 they do by design, killing the headline feature silently in long-lived stores while every fixture among AC-101..AC-139 is a fresh store. AC-142 is written population-neutral so it holds under either resolution of the new DP-9 and goes RED only on the mixed implementation; AC-109/112/117/134 amended to carry the status axis. vigil final delta re-critique round 3 (both round-2 deviations UPHELD — vigil withdrew their own AC-140 prescription after checking its premise, and ruled the DP-9 active-only argument stronger than their all-statuses position; refine cycle-2 bar failed again on testability 3). H-1 BLOCKING, accepted: AC-142 — the sole oracle for G-2 — could not fail on the defect it names. Its saturating fixture was chosen to keep DP-9 neutrality, and that neutrality destroyed it: under the MIXED population the numerator exceeds the denominator, 1-n/N goes negative, and the clamp mandated by D3 (mandatory because AC-112 requires the [1,1+alpha] bound) floors it to 0, returning w_sparse=1.0 — identical to both pure populations. Reproduced across every fixture shape the GIVEN admits (N/M = 100/50, 10/5, 5/5, 50/200: 1.0 under all three implementations), so revision 1.2.0's closing sentence 'only the mixed implementation gives a non-zero boost' was FALSE. This is R-7's third occurrence. Repair: AC-142's THEN now asserts the population-agreement INVARIANT (sparse-arm count no greater than the searched-layer count that produced it), which discriminates on the identical fixtures — all-statuses 150<=150 holds, active-only 100<=100 holds, mixed 150<=100 VIOLATED — while staying DP-9-neutral; observability already exists via revision 1.2.0's AC-117 explain.fusion population surface. Wording refinement recorded: vigil's literal fix was a compound THEN, so the discriminating half became the normative clause and the non-discriminating w_sparse==1.0 check is retained in VERIFY as a companion regression assertion (one criterion, one assertion). Non-saturating fixtures were verified unusable: at 1 active + 50 deprecated the three implementations give 1.66/1.99/1.49, so the two pure populations disagree and no value assertion can be DP-9-neutral. C-1: AC-141's escape hatch now reads 'cannot go green', harmonised with AC-139's convention for the structurally identical role. C-2: AC-140's exclusion from AC-136's contingency is no longer the spec's assumption but FORGE's explicit DP-4(ii) ruling; AC-136 records its list as pending that ruling. 42 -> 42 criteria; amended AC-136, AC-141, AC-142; none added, none removed.

Assemble-phase correction of vigil terminal note N-2, on an APPROVE-FOR-ASSEMBLE verdict against b17f209a8944. GUIDANCE-ONLY: the normative GIVEN/WHEN/WHILE/WHERE/THEN clauses of all 42 blocks are BYTE-IDENTICAL to revision 1.3.0, proven mechanically — sha256 of the extracted clause lines is 689ec372b3e895e6ad6abc08d6eba9710c34401b5dafc15a42c323f5e20da058 both before and after this edit. Substance: revision 1.3.0 labelled AC-142's w_sparse==1.0 check 'a companion non-discriminating regression check'. That label was WRONG and understated the criterion, as vigil found by enumerating every population pairing; I reproduced all four before accepting. At the saturating fixture (N=100 active, M=50 deprecated): all-statuses 150/150 invariant holds, w=1.0 (correct); active-only 100/100 holds, w=1.0 (correct); MIXED 150/100 invariant VIOLATED, w=1.0 — caught by the invariant ALONE; REVERSE (active numerator against all-statuses denominator) 100/150 invariant HOLDS, w=1.3333 — caught by the WEIGHT ALONE. The reverse mismatch is precisely the error an implementer makes by filtering one end of DP-9's ruling and forgetting the other. The two assertions are therefore COMPLEMENTARY, each covering a mismatch direction the other cannot, and together covering all four pairings; neither is redundant. VERIFY now requires both explicitly and carries the four-row complementarity table so verification.md cannot transcribe the wrong label. The wording note is corrected to say the compound-THEN split was a grammar split, not a demotion in importance. Rationale for amending rather than carrying a note: the refine cap (3/3) bars further refine CYCLES via ramza-gate refine, not amendments via ramza-freeze — the two gates are independent — and shipping a known-wrong label into the checker handoff would be the documented-caveat-standing-in-for-a-fix pattern this campaign rejects. Instrument used is the tamper-evident one; the approval-basis hash is named above so the delta is auditable in one diff. 42 -> 42 criteria; none added, amended-normative none, removed none.
